content: Cloudflare's DoH JSON API intentionally mirrors Google's dns.google schema for compatibility, but the DoH JSON format has no formal RFC (RFC 8484 standardizes only DNS wireformat over HTTPS, not JSON), so providers can diverge - documented issue includes different TXT record quoting behavior between resolvers. Google retains some query logs up to 2 weeks; Cloudflare commits to no persistent query logging (relevant for an EU/privacy-positioned tool choosing a primary resolver).
